entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Yogesh Dutta Mishra,Manjulesh Kumar Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
List has been revised.
Sri Yogesh Dutta Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State are present.
No one is present on behalf of opposite party no.2.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that it is a matrimonial dispute between the parties and several cases were lodged by the opposite party no.2 against the applicant.

This Court vide order dated 11.10.2007 had referred the matter before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre,
High Court Allahabad passed in Application U/S 482 No. 25540 of 2007.

entities.text:
Mediation and Conciliation Centre,
High Court Allahabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In compliance of order dated 11.10.2007, parties were appeared before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre and settled their dispute amicably with the help of mediators and a written agreement was taken place on 22.06.2008.

sentences.text: It is agreed by husband and wife that the applicant no.1 who is husband will pay Rs. 1,40,000/- to Smt. Roma(wife), daughter of opposite party no.2 within three months and it is also agreed between the parties that all the criminal proceedings initiated against the applicants will be withdrawn by the opposite party no.2.
The agreement dated 22.06.2008 was also signed by opposite party no.2, who is father of Smt. Roma(wife).
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant no.1 has deposited the amount of Rs. 1,40,000/- on 19.08.2008.
Criminal proceedings initiated by opposite party no.2 under Section 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act, was quashed by this Court by order dated 23.09.2015, passed in Application U/S 482 25540 of 2007.
In view of the aforesaid fact, since the parties have amicably settled their dispute outside the Court and a written compromise has taken place between the parties.
There is no occassion in keeping the matter pending.
The present Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. is liable to be allowed.

Accordingly, the present Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed and proceedings of Complaint Case No.107 of 2008(Raj Kumar Vs. Rajeev)) under Section 406 IPC, Police Station Kandhala, District Shamali as well as summoning order dated 07.06.2008 and non bailable warrant order dated 04.08.2021, are hereby quashed.
